title: HoleFeature
description: Parametric Hole feature: creates a cylindrical cut (simple, counterbore, or countersink) at a given position. Supports blind depth or through-all extents. Tool mesh is generated and Boolean-cut against the part body when operation=cut.

hole_type.description: Hole variant: simple cylinder, counterbore (stepped), or countersink (conical)

diameter.description: Hole diameter: numeric value or parameter name / expression string

depth.description: Hole depth for blind holes. Numeric or parameter/expression. Positive value. Ignored when extent=through_all (a large default is used).

extent.description: Extent of the hole. 'blind' uses depth; 'through_all' generates a long tool cylinder that fully pierces typical part bodies (depth is ignored or used as a minimum).

through_depth.description: Optional explicit length for through_all tool cylinder. Defaults to a large value (1000) if omitted.

countersink_diameter.description: Countersink major diameter. Required for hole_type=countersink.

countersink_angle.description: Countersink included angle in degrees (default 82 or 90). Optional.

center.description: Optional center position [x, y] or [x, y, z]. Defaults to origin. Z is the start plane.

direction.description: Optional direction vector of the hole axis (defaults to [0, 0, -1] or sketch normal).

segments.description: Facet count for the cylinder approximation

operation.description: Boolean operation intent. 'cut' subtracts the tool cylinder from the current part body.
